judgments.rationale: PSD2 evidentiary-burden scholarship and Motorola US20250069082A1 (fraud warnings for reversal requests) are adjacent; comprehension quizzes exist in e-consent. New element: an accessibility-adaptive warning with a risk-specific comprehension check, bound to the payment in a signed receipt. Eligibility depends on claiming the receipt and log mechanics.

No art found that uses victim-entered payee labels (public-figure and narrative lexicon) against the confirmation-of-payee legal name. Payment-reference keyword screening is known practice, so claim the label-versus-legal-name semantic distance and the cumulative session audit. Text classification alone carries §101 / §3(k) risk.

Amazon US12300035B1 (liveness from motion, face and context cues against injection and deepfakes), 3DMM-fit residual analysis in face-forgery research, and commercial occlusion/deformation challenges cover the core. The blendshape-basis framing is a narrow variant.

Rater-reliability and collusion-robust truth inference (Dawid-Skene family, sybil-resistant reputation) and review-fraud detection patents (US20260212362A1) anticipate it; applying them to scam-report crowds is an obvious substitution.
Automated GST/PAN/registration verification and perpetual-KYC exception routing are offered by Indian KYC vendors. Using signed government records for re-KYC is an obvious extension.

Motorola's reversal-request warnings and RANGERS.AI scam-message remediation are adjacent. No art found for a fraud-report-triggered protected state keyed to recovery-scam narratives plus a signed case-communication channel. Claim the state transition and the signed verification flow.

Policy literature on reserve-backed and shared stablecoins does not describe per-member tranche attestation with automatic mint gating and waterfall recapitalisation. Value depends on how many consortium stablecoins emerge; check Coinbase/Circle filings.
